precepts.why:
“Then came up John from Gazera, and told Simon his father”. Simon is one of the brothers of Judas Maccabeus, and their family is the Hasmonean dynasty. His son is John Hyrcanus.

John Hyrcanus subdued all of Idumea and forcibly converted its people to what is called Judaism today. That is where you get the Jewish people from. The Hasmoneans were Israelites, but over time they began to wane from the laws and brought the Idumeans into the political party, while they paid tribute to Rome.

From that came Antipater, the father of Herod the Great. So the Herod in whose days Christ was born was an Edomite who had been brought in among us.

precepts.why: “When Simon saw that John his son was a valiant man, he made him captain of all the hosts; and he dwelt in Gazera.” That is the same John who comes up from Gazera in 16:1: John Hyrcanus, Simon’s son, the captain of all the hosts.

precepts.why:
A history of one of our forefathers and drunkenness. Simon was set up: “So when Simon and his sons had drunk largely, Ptolemee and his men rose up, and took their weapons, and came upon Simon into the banqueting place, and slew him, and his two sons.” Notice it says he had drunk largely.

Yes, he was set up to be killed, but he might have had a chance if he was not drunk. When you are drunk you are not in control, and that is how the enemy comes; it is the same as getting behind the wheel drunk. It was the same over the rape in the days of Levi: the men were circumcised and had no control, and they came and killed them all; and the revolution in Haiti started when they let the French get drunk and then moved in. Read the history of Maccabees: that is about our forefathers.

At the feast days, brothers serving should keep their eyes open for those who keep coming back for more. Be your brother’s keeper: pull the brother to the side and tell him he doesn’t need any more, and don’t let each other leave your houses intoxicated.

The War Between Blacks And Whites

points: This is the family tree of our ancestors, the Maccabees. The Hasmonean dynasty refers to Simon: Hasmonean is Simeon, so the Hasmonean dynasty is the descendants of Simon. Simon Maccabeus had a son named John Hyrcanus.

The history in Josephus shows what John Hyrcanus did. He conquered the whole of Edom and forced its people to convert to Judaism. He took Dora and Marissa, cities of Idumea, and Idumea is Edom. He let the Idumeans stay in the country if they would circumcise themselves and make use of the laws of the Jews: Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy and the other books. They so desired to live in that country that they submitted to circumcision and the Jewish ways of living, and from then on they were no other than Jews. These were white people. Now you have white people wearing fringes, circumcising themselves and keeping the sabbath day, because they were under our government and forced to live under God’s laws.
“Then came up John from Gazera”. This John is John Hyrcanus.

This is Simon speaking to his son: “I, and my brethren, and my father’s house, have ever from my youth unto this day fought against the enemies of Israel; and things have prospered so well in our hands, that we have delivered Israel oftentimes.”

points: “As concerning the rest of the acts of John, and his wars, and worthy deeds which he did”. This is still John Hyrcanus. Part of those wars were the wars he had against Edom. Our forefathers knew in the records what John did.

points: “These are written in the chronicles of his priesthood, from the time he was made high priest after his father.” We don’t have that book, so we rely on Josephus and other sources. But Esau knows this. We forced the Edomites to keep the laws of God.
